notes.content: An unsigned visible page of a typed English letter dated at Voorschoten, with a French quotation and handwritten mathematical/punctuation additions. Paragraph 1 asks whether describing a covering by its behaviour over special covers gives the intended intuition. Paragraph 2 asks about the definition of Galois coverings, commuting actions and full faithfulness of geometric realization. Paragraph 3 asks whether example 3a consists of pairs M=(a,n), and suggests replacing the displayed inequality by a componentwise-multiple condition. These are the letter writer’s questions and claims, not mathematical conclusions verified in this run. All words in the three paragraphs and all agreed C/H signs were visually read from the two supplied halves. S.json is an empty array, so there are no S rows to confirm or overturn.

The relation before the proposed replacement is greater-than-or-equal with a slanted lower stroke, not strict greater-than. This was settled by ink in crop 08.
The replacement expression has a visible prime, an equals sign, and a baseline period between separately underlined m and n. It is retained without converting the period into a raised dot.
